INSERT INTO defi_yield_opportunities (
  optimization_id,
  pool_id,
  chain,
  project,
  symbol,
  raw_apy,
  risk_adjusted_apy,
  tvl_usd,
  risk_rating,
  recommendation,
  optimal_allocation,
  ai_analysis
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.optimization_id }}',
  '{{ $json.pool.id }}',
  '{{ $json.pool.chain }}',
  '{{ $json.pool.project }}',
  '{{ $json.pool.symbol }}',
  {{ $json.pool.apy }},
  {{ $json.metrics.risk_adjusted_apy }},
  {{ $json.pool.tvl_usd }},
  '{{ $json.ai_analysis.risk_rating }}',
  '{{ $json.ai_analysis.recommendation }}',
  {{ $json.ai_analysis.optimal_allocation_percentage || 0 }},
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.ai_analysis) }}'
) RETURNING *;
